editModel.title: Edit Model: {{modelId}}
editModel.description: Configure model capabilities by toggling the options below.

warning.title: Proceed with Caution
warning.description: Modifying model capabilities may affect performance and functionality. Incorrect settings could cause unexpected behavior or errors.

baseUrl.title: Base URL
baseUrl.azureDescription: Your Azure OpenAI endpoint. Replace YOUR-RESOURCE-NAME with your Azure resource name.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.description: Enter your API key. You can add extra keys in Advanced, and Jan will try the next one automatically if a key fails.
apiKeys.testHint: Checks /models with each key and shows per-key status.
apiKeys.oneKeyHint: Optional fallback keys are configured in Advanced.

llamacpp_backend.title: Backend
llamacpp_backend.description: Hardware backend for llama.cpp (CUDA, HIP/ROCm, Vulkan, CPU, etc.)

llamacpp_env.title: Environmental variables
llamacpp_env.description: Environmental variables for llama.cpp(KEY=VALUE), separated by ';'

check_for_updates.title: Check for updates
check_for_updates.description: Fetch the remote llama.cpp release list. Required for the version dropdown to show releases beyond what's installed locally, and for update notifications.

auto_update_engine.title: Auto update engine
auto_update_engine.description: Automatically download and switch to the latest llamacpp engine when available. Requires network access on startup.

verify_backend_deps.title: Verify backend dependencies
verify_backend_deps.description: Check that GPU backend shared libraries (CUDA, Vulkan, etc.) resolve on startup

models_max.title: Max Concurrently Loaded Models
models_max.description: Maximum number of models the router will keep loaded at once. 0 = unlimited.

timeout.title: Timeout for llamacpp
timeout.description: Llamacpp connection and load timeout in seconds

fit.title: Fit (auto-adjust to device memory)
fit.description: Whether to adjust unset arguments to fit in device memory ('on' or 'off').

fit_target.title: Fit Target per Device (MiB)
fit_target.description: Target margin per device for fit, comma-separated list of MiB values.

fit_ctx.title: Fit Minimum Context Size
fit_ctx.description: Minimum context size (tokens) that can be set by the auto-fit option.

threads.title: Threads
threads.description: Number of threads to use during generation (-1 for logical cores).

threads_batch.title: Threads (Batch)
threads_batch.description: Number of threads for batch and prompt processing.

ctx_shift.title: Context Shift
ctx_shift.description: Allow model to cut text in the beginning to accommodate new text in its memory

n_predict.title: Max Tokens to Predict
n_predict.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate (-1 = infinity).

ubatch_size.title: uBatch Size
ubatch_size.description: Physical maximum batch size for processing prompts.

device.title: Devices for Offload
device.description: Comma-separated list of devices to use for offloading.

split_mode.title: GPU Split Mode
split_mode.description: How to split the model across multiple GPUs.

main_gpu.title: Main GPU Index
main_gpu.description: The GPU to use for the model (split-mode=none) or intermediate results.

flash_attn.title: Flash Attention
flash_attn.description: Enable Flash Attention for optimized performance.

parallel.title: Parallel Sequences
parallel.description: Number of parallel sequences to decode for your own chat requests.

cont_batching.title: Continuous Batching
cont_batching.description: Enable continuous batching for concurrent requests.

no_mmap.title: Disable mmap
no_mmap.description: Do not memory-map model (slower load but may reduce pageouts if not using mlock)

mlock.title: MLock
mlock.description: Force system to keep model in RAM, preventing swapping/compression.

cache_type_k.title: KV Cache K Type
cache_type_k.description: KV cache data type for Keys (default: f16).

cache_type_v.title: KV Cache V Type
cache_type_v.description: KV cache data type for Values (default: f16).

rope_freq_base.title: RoPE Frequency Base
rope_freq_base.description: RoPE base frequency (0 = loaded from model).

cache_ram.title: Prompt Cache RAM (MiB)
cache_ram.description: Maximum prompt cache size in MiB. -1 = unlimited, 0 = disabled.

cache_reuse.title: Cache Reuse
cache_reuse.description: Min chunk size of matching prefix tokens to reuse from cache. 0 = disabled.

swa_full.title: Full SWA Cache
swa_full.description: Use full-size KV cache for sliding-window-attention models.

kv_unified.title: Unified KV Cache
kv_unified.description: Use a single unified KV buffer shared across all slots. Saves memory when running multiple sessions.

keep.title: Keep First N Tokens
keep.description: Number of tokens from the initial prompt to keep when context is shifted. -1 = keep everything.

batch_size.title: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Logical maximum batch size for processing prompts.

n_cpu_moe.title: MoE Layers on CPU
n_cpu_moe.description: Keep the Mixture-of-Experts weights of the first N layers in CPU memory. Lets a large MoE model fit in limited VRAM. 0 disables it.

no_kv_offload.title: Disable KV Cache Offload
no_kv_offload.description: Keep the KV cache in system RAM instead of GPU memory. Useful when VRAM is scarce, at the cost of speed.

tensor_split.title: Tensor Split
tensor_split.description: Comma-separated proportions for splitting the model across devices, e.g. "3,1". Leave empty for an even split.

no_op_offload.title: Disable Op Offload
no_op_offload.description: Keep host tensor operations on the CPU instead of offloading them to the accelerator.

persist_thread_cache.title: Remember Conversations Between Sessions
persist_thread_cache.description: Keep each conversation's prompt cache on disk so reopening it does not re-read the whole conversation. Restored only when the model, its settings and the llama.cpp build all match what saved it.

thread_cache_size.title: Conversation Cache Disk Limit (MiB)
thread_cache_size.description: Disk budget for saved conversation caches (default: 8192). The oldest are dropped first once it is reached. One long conversation can take hundreds of MiB.

ctx_checkpoints.title: Context Checkpoints
ctx_checkpoints.description: Maximum context checkpoints kept per slot, which let a shifted context be restored instead of reprocessed.

checkpoint_min_step.title: Checkpoint Minimum Step
checkpoint_min_step.description: Minimum number of tokens between context checkpoints.
